args.title: Tamarack Components Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Warehouse automation in 2026" highlights autonomous carts as the key driver of efficiency gains in warehouses this year.
- Linked article: Pick rates rose 18% thanks to autonomous carts, but integration with existing systems took roughly twice as long as originally planned.
- Companion piece: The single biggest cost saving from the automation rollout came from a reduction in mis-picks (picking errors), rather than from raw speed gains.

Note: Skipped the newsletter's "subscriber" companion link because it required embedding your work email in a third-party tracking URL; fetched the companion piece via the plain link found in the article instead.
